replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation: The $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. The deciding fact is the driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00201, 98 driver fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps): it never brings the vehicle closer than 779.93 m to the pickup pin at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive, and records zero fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only if the trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event; that limb fails on the driver's own telemetry, as the Driver Advocate properly and candidly conceded, and the dwell limb fails with it (0 seconds against the 300-second minimum). POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each reach the same result independently, and POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider as well. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee: that clause covers a driver stationary within 400 m of the pin at the wrong face of the venue, and this driver was never within 779 m, so the 400 m ceiling is never met and no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises. On the rider's side, POL-NS-04 is satisfied on all three limbs: the rider sent a locating message at 08:05:33 naming the block and saying he could not see the vehicle, the driver posted no reply and made no in-app call before cancelling, and the rider track (122 fixes, maximum 24.9 m from the pin, zero fixes filtered for accuracy) places him inside the 100 m presence radius for every qualifying fix. The 'arrived' marker at 08:02:14 is a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: at that timestamp the driver was hundreds of metres outside the 300 m threshold, so the marker does not start the waiting clock, and because there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full and directs the false-arrival record carried in the referrals list. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not, and in any event the anti-farming check on driver_profile (3 no-show terminations across 96 completed trips in 30 days, 3.1%) trips neither limb of that clause. I considered escalation and it is not warranted. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08: there is no material clock skew (the arrival event sits within seconds of a trace fix), the trace has no gap over 120 seconds and carries the rider track, the chat log's two messages match the trip record's chat_message_count and its msg_id sequence is intact, and the $4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule (GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee of $4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of $4.00). Confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no cross-party dispute counters are present on either profile, and the apparent tension between the trip record's arrival marker and the trace is exactly the conflict POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, so it is not an open contradiction requiring human review. The refund covers the cancellation-fee line only ($4.00); it does not extend to any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record trip TRP-00201 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-01590 in the platform's false-arrival register, the 'arrived' marker at 2026-07-23T08:02:14+08:00 having been set while the driver's own trace placed him roughly 780 m from the pickup pin and no qualifying in-geofence fix existing anywhere in the trip.
